utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. First, we need to sort the donated parts and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll sort the donated parts and make a quick list of what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the logistics—do we know where people should drop things off and when?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have a confirmed drop-off spot and time yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet—I’d feel better once we have a clear spot and a window for drop-off. Otherwise people may show up at the wrong place or time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I missed the details — what are we fixing and when do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — we’re fixing up a few things around the block, mostly small repairs. I’m sorry, I don’t have the full details in front of me, but I’ll check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others and keep the repair drive plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll keep everyone posted and line up the next steps for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — we’re still on track. I’ve got a few tools set aside if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — that’s helpful. I’ll swing by and see what I can use.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing first, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s start with the safety stuff first, like broken steps and loose railings, then move to the smaller fixes. I can gather folks and we can kick off Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning works for me. Let’s start with the steps and railings first, then we can move down the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and do you need any tools or volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Mina — yes, it’s still on for Saturday. We could use a few volunteers, and if you have a drill or screwdrivers, those would be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I can help for a few hours and bring my drill and screwdrivers. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be wonderful, Jules — could you help me keep track of who can help and where they’d like to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep a simple list of who can help and what they’d like to do. Just send me the names and their spots, and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs to be organized?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’m putting together the supply list and matching folks to jobs, so your help is perfect. Could you take a look at the donation boxes and let me know what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check the donation boxes and tell you what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list ready for the repair drive—just tell me what’s needed most and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — let’s start with paint, screws, and a few basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll note paint, screws, and basic tools first. If you think of anything else, send it my way and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already—folks have been dropping off tools and a few extra supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s good to hear. I’m glad people are pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It really is nice to see. I’m going to swing by later and see if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details again? I want to make sure I get everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I can remind you, but I don’t have the details in front of me right now. If you share what you already know, I’ll help you check it over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the details yet either, so let’s verify them together first. If you remember even a few specifics, I can help check them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the basics and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll send you the basics and the drop-off details right now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send the basics and drop-off spot, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll keep coordinating here and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep passing along updates about the repair drive as things get set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I’m a bit out of the loop—what changed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s still happening, just moving a little slower than we hoped. I’m trying to keep it on track, but I may need a hand if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — thanks for the update. If you need a hand, I can probably help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive, Gus. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — if you’ve got a hammer, a screwdriver set, and maybe some spare nails, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got a hammer and a screwdriver set—I’ll bring those by, and I’ll see if I can find some spare nails too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’ve got the repair drive organized and ready to go. Want to help me sort the list or spread the word to the neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Happy to help sort the list — I’ll keep track of who’s been contacted and what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal — thank you. I’ll start the list with the urgent fixes, and you can note who we’ve reached so far.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and what needs to be brought so I can plan properly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the repair drive is this Saturday from 10 to 2, and we could use basic tools, work gloves, and any spare hardware you’ve got. If you want, I can save you a spot and send the full list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — please save me a spot and send the full list, and I’ll check what I can bring before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen the final confirmation yet—let me check the details before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s not confirmed yet? Let me know as soon as you check.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple and steady. What’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll show up a little late, but I can still help once I’m there. Just tell me where to meet and what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s meet at the front of my place around 10, and we’ll start with the loose railing first. If you’re running late, just text me and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting started soon—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think they still need a few basics—tools, batteries, and maybe some extension cords. I can check my list and let you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great — I’m still piecing things together from second-hand updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a little foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — we’re gathering folks to fix up small things around the block, like loose hinges, leaky taps, and broken steps. If you’re free, I can put you down for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning sounds good—put me down. If you remind me what to bring, I’ll try not to forget it again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive times first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. I’ll send the repair drive times over right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send them over and I’ll work around pickup.
